method_input: Sanitized RGBDFrames and first-hit visible_owner masks reconstructed with frozen mapper and InstanceSupportIndex
model_output: All tracks, particle prior/energy and observed axis. No scalar choice or prior fitting.
prior: Continuous uniform depth0.2..1.4; fixed0.1m nodes with Voronoi mass and acquired-span conditioning as method defines.
selection: Independent evaluator chooses train-only equal-object/equal-condition CRPS; ties choose larger sigma; validation and heldout evaluate once after selected scale frozen.
failure_handling: Actor preserves all missing/multiple tracks and failures. Evaluator fallback is unconditional public uniform[.2,1.4] with world-y axis, independent of sigma; no GT-based selection. Full denominator and separate failure rates retained.
axis_evaluation: Evaluator projects private true vertices onto inferred depth axis; yaw/axis mismatch separately reported. No private projected truth enters actor.
